speaker: Narrator
text: Snow drifts across the high pass. Rook spots a shape under a pine.

speaker: Rook
text: Rook digs out the courier, alive but half frozen, the treaty still sealed in its case.

speaker: Courier
text: "You found me," the courier whispers. "The treaty is safe."

speaker: Narrator
text: Rook wraps him in a blanket and turns the horses back toward the garrison.
